title: Head to Toe Touch Pike
author: Justin
desc: Unlock your full potential with the Head to Toe Touch Pike program, a focused 3-week journey designed for flexibility and strength. Committing just one day a week, you'll engage in a variety of dynamic exercises such as the One Bent Leg Assisted Toe Touch and Seated Pike Lift, targeting your entire body. Each session emphasizes controlled movements and post-isometric relaxation techniques, ensuring you not only build strength but also enhance your mobility. Get ready to challenge yourself and transform your fitness routine!

ex.n: One Bent Leg Assisted Toe Touch (3-5 Seconds)
Passive Straight Leg On Wall (Post Isometric Relaxation)

ex.note: Back against wall, point toes, can work one leg at a time. Hands flat on ground, the closer to wall means more supported.
